newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada board sets hearing for Federated plan.
newsitem.headline: Canada board sets hearing for Federated plan.

text.p: Canada's National Energy Board said on Tuesday it would hold a public hearing in February into Federated Pipe Lines (Northern) Ltd's application to build and operate an oil and natural gas liquids pipeline to Belloy, Alberta from Taylor, British Columbia.

Federated, co-owned by Anderson Exploration Ltd and Imperial Oil Ltd, was aiming to build the 172 km, 10-inch diamter pipeline to transport crude oil, segregated condensate, ethane plus and propane plus to an interconnection with a proposed pipeline at Belloy.
Construction of the 52,000 barrel per day line was scheduled to start in the summer of 1997 and be completed in the winter of 1997-98, with startup slated for the spring of 1998.
The NEB said the hearing into the C$41-million project would begin on February 24 in Calgary. ((-- Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
